title: Cocommutative Hopf Dialgebras and Rack Combinatorics
summary: We study cocommutative Hopf dialgebras through generalized digroups and rack combinatorics. We prove that the rack functor obtained from the adjoint rack bialgebra factorizes through the digroup of group-like elements. More precisely, for every cocommutative Hopf dialgebra $A$, the rack of set-like elements of its adjoint rack bialgebra is naturally isomorphic to the conjugation rack of the digroup $\Glike(A)$. For finite generalized digroups $D\simeq G\times E$, with $G$ acting on the halo $E$, we derive explicit formulas for the conjugation rack, its inner group, left-translation cycle…
